contract: Key order in plain JSON input and in search attribute validation (published Server 2.11.7 with Workflow 2.15.7: PayloadEnvelopeResolver::resolve, Avro::toDatum and SearchAttributeValueValidator), over raw HTTP in a fresh namespace without registered search attributes. Each body is sent exactly as written here. A start's plain input becomes its values in document order (array_values), so an object input with integer keys out of order and an object input with named keys keep the order they were written in. A nested object is encoded as an Avro map in document order, which the stored input blob shows. An integer-keyed nested object that is not a list in document order (`{"1":"a","0":"b"}`) is refused with 422 validation_failed and the serializer's invalid_map_key message under workflow_type, and no run is created. A signal's plain input is stored the same way. Several invalid search attributes on one start, and on one upsert_search_attributes command, are reported in request order.
